szenen.text: Stocks and crypto are crashing at the same time. Why?
The AI trade is unwinding. Chip stocks fell about 8%, Tesla about 10%, the Nasdaq about 5%.
After the Democratic sweep, investors expect more scrutiny of the AI data-center buildout.
Crypto followed. About 400 million dollars of leveraged longs were wiped out within one hour.
Next up: the US jobs report on Friday. Overreaction or just the start? Comment below.
